replication.target_description: Study 3a, first replication of Mandel (2002), Experiment 1: overall seller-versus-buyer comparison of log-transformed wine prices, independent-samples ownership main-effect t-test, collapsing transaction-demand conditions.

es.location: Manuscript p. 21, Study 3a Results; p. 45, Table 7.
es.quote:
In an independent samples t-test we found a medium to strong ownership effect, with

sellers’ mean log price (M = 2.71, SD = .85) higher than buyers’ mean log price (M = 2.21,

SD = .68; t(295.06) = 5.71, p < .001, d = .65).
